propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts on lines 249 and 250 of test_llm_fallback_chain.py where startswith() is used to compare URL strings
startswith() prefix matching on URLs is insufficient to validate host equality because attacker-controlled suffixes can be appended (e.g. https://fallback.test.evil.example/ passes the prefix check)

The test assertions must compare parsed URL origins (scheme and netloc) via exact equality using urllib.parse.urlsplit rather than substring matching to preserve the intended property while eliminating the weakness
After the fix, both alerts must be reported as fixed by CodeQL's re-scan with zero open alerts of any rule on the repository, and no dismissal or suppression comment is added
